verdict.rationale: Circle is a hosted stablecoin, wallet, and payments API platform. Self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, but nothing in the evidence shows a deployable or self-hostable version of the core product. CPN's "Self-managed" mode means the customer runs its own custody, payouts, and compliance while Circle still provides the rails and APIs, so it is an adjacent operating model, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
